notes.title: ASURAJANG Season 1 Update
notes.notes:
On Thursday, July 17, 2025, from 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM (UTC+9), a game update will be conducted.

During the maintenance period for the update, you will not be able to access the game. Please take this into consideration when planning your gameplay.

Hello, ASURAJANG users!

Finally, the long Season 0 and Pre-Season are over, and the first regular season, Season 1, is about to begin!

We would like to express our deepest gratitude to all users who have waited patiently for this moment. As previously announced in the developer's notes, Season 1 includes numerous changes. Due to the volume of updates, we will first share a brief summary at the beginning, followed by detailed update notes in the latter section.


[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/7642290443b8e0ec9c46673ef9c4e6a666ab9fba.png"]
[Summary of Major Changes][olist]
With the start of the new season, Season 0 records have been reset.

3v3 Arena Mode has been added.

A Rank Rating system has been introduced.

New character Brunn joins ASURAJANG!

New character Erin joins ASURAJANG!

A Pre-made Party Restriction feature has been added.

A Rank Placement system has been introduced.

An Account Icon system has been added.

A feature preventing party formation with blocked players has been added.

The Battle Pass has been updated.

XP gained from Missions have been significantly increased.

Numerous new Achievement missions have been added.

Character balance has been adjusted across the board.

The Asia server will be merged with the East Asia server.
[/olist][hr][/hr][Season 0 Records Reset]
Season levels have been reset.

The number of Battle Shards possessed by players has been reset.

Rankings have been reset.
[New Mode - Arena]
Arena Mode is a 3v3 mode where players engage in duels based purely on skill to determine the winner.

It is played in a series of rounds, where the first team to reach 3 round wins claims victory. A maximum of 5 rounds can be played before a victor is determined.

Rounds 1~3 are 3v3 team fights, while rounds 4~5 are tag team matches.

In Arena Mode, you do not participate using the character selected in the lobby; instead, there is a Character Pick Phase.

Teams with lower MMR start with the first pick, and subsequent picks alternate between teams. The player with the lowest MMR gets the first pick.

Picking the same character is not allowed.

Character combinations can result in significant advantages or disadvantages, so strategic character selection through active communication is advantageous.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/4baf6695c653a20f569a56bf21ea3c109d2d513c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/3d40f85017bc80d2230ef8996fd577b4e8fa1f41.jpg"]
[New System - Rank Tier System]
The Rank Tier System is a system applied to Battle Royale Mode and Arena Mode.

Rank Tiers are divided into two leagues.

These are the [Challenge League] and [Master League].

The [Challenge League] consists of five tiers: Rookie, Initiate, Expert, Elite, and Champion.

In the [Challenge League], you earn RP, and when your RP reaches a certain score, you are promoted to the next rank.

When your RP reaches 3,500 or more, you are promoted to the [Master] rank and move to the [Master League].

The [Master League] is divided into three tiers: Master, Grand Master, and Asura.

Once you reach the [Master League], you cannot be demoted to a lower tier, and you begin earning CP points. Additionally, you must reach the [Master League] to be listed on the rank leaderboard.

If you enter the top 100 overall rankings in the [Master League], you will be granted the Asura rank. The Asura rank is updated once a day.
[Ranking Menu]
As explained above, only users who have reached the Master League will be listed in the rank leaderboard.

Users will now be displayed together across all servers, rather than separately by matchmaking server.
[New Character - Brunn]
Brunn from Vergerant joins ASURAJANG.

He is a character who fights with a giant partisan, characterized by his long range, powerful damage, and toughness.

Can be purchased using Fight Money or D-CREDIT, and is available for free for those who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass.
[New Character - Erin]
Erin from Vergerant joins the battle in ASURAJANG.

Erin is a mage character who uses elemental magic in cycles, and has various combos and crowd control abilities through element cycling.

Can be purchased using Fight Money or D-CREDIT, and is available for free for those who purchase the Season 1 Battle Pass.
[Pre-made Party Restrictions]
Pre-made party restrictions have been introduced.

Players who have reached [Master League] in the ranks mentioned above will receive pre-made party restrictions.

Players in the [Challenge League] can form pre-made parties.

If a player in the [Master League] is in the party, matchmaking will be disabled.
[Placement Match System]
A Placement Match system has been introduced.

Applies to Battle Royale Mode and Arena Mode, and Placement Matches will be conducted over 5 matches.

Players' initial Rank Tiers will be determined based on the results of their Placement Matches.
[Account Icon System]
An Account Icon system has been added.

Acquire Account Icons through various routes to express your individuality!
[Season 1 Battle Pass]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44628388/4aeb1cd3f3321fb6a27664d49c3460aacdd27a6b.png"]

All Battle Pass items have been replaced.

The new Battle Pass can be purchased for 2,000 D-CREDIT.

When purchasing the Battle Pass, the Brunn and Erin characters are provided additionally.

The number of obtainable items has increased from 41 to 85.

You can receive 900 D-CREDIT from completing it.

You can obtain 10,000 Fight Money.
[Player Block Feature Improvement]
You will no longer be able to join the same party as blocked players.

The more you are blocked, the more likely you are to be excluded from party matching, which may result in longer matchmaking times.
[Mission Changes]
XP provided by missions have been increased by approximately 5 times compared to the previous version.

30 new Achievement missions have been added.

Some missions with difficult requirements have been removed to make Daily Missions easier to complete.
[Matchmaking Server]
The Asia server has been merged with the East Asia server.

The existing Asia server had too few players, resulting in very little matchmaking.

We felt that maintaining the Asia server under these circumstances would only be detrimental to the player experience and ASURAJANG, so we decided that merging it with East Asia to increase the matchmaking pool was the right decision.
[Characters]
With the introduction of the arena, the importance of windup and recovery animations has become very significant. To address this, we have adjusted the windup/recovery animations for all characters. Specifically, to distinguish between risk and reward, we have made it impossible to cancel recovery animations following attacks with dodges, which was previously possible. However, since the overall post-attack recovery animation length has been reduced, we anticipate that the sense of frustration will be slightly reduced. Additionally, to prevent jump attacks from becoming low-risk, high-reward actions, we have increased jump stamina consumption and adjusted jump attack stamina consumption and damage. Furthermore, we are improving actions that were statistically underused to make them more balanced. Please refer to the details below for more information.
Common
Jump stamina has been increased from 100 to 130.

The windup/recovery animations of all characters has been adjusted.

Stamina recovery speed has been increased from 240 to 280 per second.

Payra's Extra Action has been separated into a parry and a slash.

After successfully parrying a melee attack, press the Extra Action key again to perform “Swift Slice,” in which Payra performs a wide slash as she did previously.

“Swift Slice” consumes stamina.

The hitbox duration of Normal Action 1 has been adjusted to match other characters.

Tetanuchi

Tetanuchi is currently undergoing a full action design overhaul, and we will share further updates as they become available.

Stamina consumed on the 1st use is 150, and increases by 30 each time her Special Action is used, up to a maximum of 270.

Yeoul

Dodge Attack explosion now lands 1.5m to the front of the character.

Shoyo

Normal Action 1 windup animation length has been slightly reduced.

Extra Action recovery animation length has been reduced.

Dodge Attack recovery animation length has been reduced.
[Battle Royale - Items]
The Stun Gun and Grappling Hook now fire in the direction the character is facing (previously fired in the cursor direction), and their flight speed has been significantly reduced.

Mythic Astra - Taotie’s Orb [Devour]'s effective range has been reduced from 5m to 4m.

Mythic Astra - Dudu's Wisp Bead's special effect has been changed from [Strip] to [Wisp Flames]. The [Wisp Flames] effect causes wisp flames to explode from the owner's body upon being hit, dealing damage to surrounding enemies.
[Team Deathmatch Mode]

[Locker Items]
Season 0 Battle Pass items and Shop Bundle items can now be purchased in the Locker.

Victory Ceremony animation items have been added for some characters in the Locker.

[Bug Fixes]

Fixed a bug where the Astras equipped upon winning in Battle Royale mode were not displayed in Match Records.

Fixed a bug where items occasionally floated in the air in Battle Royale mode.

Fixed a bug where party recruitment was not canceled when joining another party during party recruitment.

notes.title: ASURAJANG UPDATE - June 12th, 2025
notes.notes:
Greetings from the ASURAJANG Team. A game update will be performed on Thursday, June 12th, 2025, from 11 am to 1 pm (UTC+9). Please note that you will not be able to access the game during the update.

  The update details are as follows. 
[hr][/hr][Dodge - Balance Changes]
The Dodge Action, designed as the only defensive action in ASURAJANG’s Combat System, enabled players to easily evade most attacks thanks to its high movement speed. After carefully monitoring the balance between Dodge and Attack actions for an extended period of time, we concluded that the Dodge action was significantly more effective than Attack actions, resulting in an imbalanced state where it was difficult to attack but easy to evade combat. Therefore, to restore the balance between offense and defense, we have decided to slightly reduce the overall effectiveness of Dodge actions, even if this means sacrificing some of the gameplay feel. In return, we will reduce the Stamina Cost of Dodge actions and increase the base value for Max Stamina to alleviate some of the frustration caused by Stamina limitations. Additionally, to prevent the difficulty of performing Perfect Dodges from increasing due to the reduced Dodge speed, we plan to slightly extend the Dodge window.

Travel distance of all characters' Dodge actions has been reduced by 15-20%. As a result, the speed of Dodge actions has also been reduced accordingly.

So-called “Bunny Hops,” which allowed players to travel larger distances quickly by Jumping while using a Dodge action have been removed.

Stamina Cost for all characters' Dodge actions have been reduced by around 15%.

Base value for Max Stamina of all characters has been increased from 1,000 to 1,200.

Dodge Invincibility Period has been slightly increased from 0.075s to 0.085s.
[hr][/hr][Dodge Counter Attack Changes]
Dodge Counter Attacks have been tweaked to allow players to hit nearby targets more easily.

Attack Range Indicators are now displayed when holding the input key for Dodge Counter Attacks.

In order to make it easier to hit nearby targets, the forward travel distance when using Dodge Counter Attacks has been reduced by around 50%.
[hr][/hr][Character - Balance Changes]
▶ Hanuman

Movement speed while using his Extra Action has been reduced by around 8%.

Recovery animation length after using Extra Action 2 and upon landing after using his Aerial Extra Action have been increased slightly.

A bug which allowed enemies to dodge his Ultimate Action by jumping has been fixed.

▶ Payra

Parry difficulty has been slightly reduced. The Parry window now starts slightly earlier during the action’s animation and the length of the Parry window has been increased slightly from 0.09s to 0.1s.

The forward travel distance for the melee Parry follow-up attack [Blazing Crescent Slash] has been greatly reduced, making it easier to hit targets.

notes.title: ASURAJANG UPDATE - April 30th, 2025
notes.notes:
[Characters]

 Ryuan’s Extra Action and Aerial Extra Action’s recovery animation length was increased by 0.1s.
 The stumble animation is no longer played when Ryuan uses his Extra Action with Dark Flames Active to arrive at a mid-air location. 

[New System - Season Level Username FX]

 Special FX are now added to Usernames as the player’s Season Level increases.
 These FX only apply to players who have purchased the Battle Pass, and the displayed FX change every 50 levels. The max FX level is reached at level 200.

[New System - Play Guide Review]

 A new feature has been added that allows players to view past Play Guides.
 This feature can be accessed via the [Game Lobby] - [Menu] - [Play Guide].

[Elimination Buffs & Data Fragment Changes]
Since Data Fragments were removed, we found that players no longer engaged in play behaviors related to occupying the surrounding space after an elimination, and were also no longer able to strategically share Data Fragments amongst Team members. Because we thought that Data Fragment drops led to more interesting play scenarios, we have made the following changes to Data Fragments. 

 Players no longer receive a permanent buff when eliminating enemies. Only their HP and Stamina are restored.
 The amount of HP restored upon eliminating an enemy has been reduced from 30% to 10%.
 Data Fragments are now dropped upon elminating enemies.
 Dropped Data Fragments now disappear after 60 seconds pass.
 The Data Fragment inventory slot has been deleted, and Data Fragments are now picked up in regular Consumable slots. Due to this change, players are now able to hold a maximum of 4 Data Fragments.
 Upon consuming Data Fragments, characters receive the [Absorbed Data] buff, and 20% of their HP is gradually restored.
 The [Absorbed Data] buff has been adjusted from a “permanent boost to All Attack by 2%, Max HP by 20, and Max Stamina by 20” to a “permanent boost to All Attack by 3%, Max HP by 30, Max Stamina by 30, and HP Regen by 1”.

[New Enemy Elimination Rewards]

 Eliminated enemies now drop 1 Astra and 1 Consumable item.
 Players with more eliminations drop better items, with distinctions made between players with 0~3, 4~6, and 7 or more eliminations.
 Players with 7 or more eliminations drop 2 Astras.

[Element - Shock Effect Changes]
We found that that the existing Shock Status Effect, that immobilized players when triggered, negatively impacted the experiences of both players who received and players who applied the Shock Effect to enemies. Therefore, we are making the following changes to the Shock Status Effect.

 The Shock Effect now reduces the Stamina Recovery Rate of affected characters. This effect can be stacked up to 3 times, and Stamina Recovery is reduced by at a rate of 20%, 40%, and 60% respectively.
 Electro Explosions now occur when players who are Shocked enter water. Electro Explosions cause AoE DMG and apply the Blow Away (Strong) effect to characters that are hit. Each stack increases the radius and DMG of the explosions.

[Battle Royale Consumables - Dudu Coin Changes]
After the maximum number of Dudu Coins that could be held by players was increased to 9 coins, we found that players were pressured into spending a great amount of their play time farming for Dudu Coins, and the Dudu Vending Machines and Gacha Machines became priority farming spots. Additionally, in Trios, we found that players were much less likely to use Vending and Gacha Machines due to their tendencies to farm in separate locations. As we had originally intended for Dudu Coins to serve as a supplementary method of farming to item drops, and to alleviate the pressure for players to spend their time farming for Dudu Coins, we are making the following changes.

 The maximum number of Dudu Coins that can be carried has been reduced from 9 to 5 coins.
 The number of Dudu Coins held by Party Members is now displayed.
 The number of Dudu Coins dropped by defeated Mimic enemies has beed reduced from 2 per Mimic and 3 per Rare Mimic to 1 per Mimic and 2 per Rare Mimic. 
 The Respawn Time for Mimic enemies has been adjusted to a fixed 150s duration.
 The drop rate of Dudu Coins from Urns has been increased.
 The drop rate of Dudu Coins from common Dudu Chests has been slightly increased.
 The number of items obtained from interacting with Dudu Gacha Machines and Vending Machines has been adjusted to 2 items, regardless of the number of coins inserted.
 The types of Astras that can be obtained from Dudu Gacha Machines have been adjusted as listed below.

 1 Coin → Uncommon, Rare
 2 Coins → Rare (High rate), Epic, Legendary (Very Low rate)
 3 Coins → Rare, Epic, Legendary (Low rate)
 4 Coins → Rare, Epic (High rate), Legendary
 5 Coins → Epic, Legendary (High rate)


[Battle Royale - Minimap]

 The locations of nearby Vending Machines, Gacha Machines, Healing Plants, Dark Spore Plants, and Mimic enemies within a certain range are now displayed on the Minimap.

[Locker]

 The Selected Character is now displayed in the Locker.
 The slot an Emoji/Emote item is equipped to is now displayed in the Locker.

[Sound]

 The ASURAJANG Game Client’s sound is no longer played when the ASURAJANG Client is running in the background. 
 As an exception, the notification sound that is played when Matchmaking is complete is still played while the game client is running in the background.

[Battle Royale - Level Objects]

[Characters]

 [Shoyo] joins ASURAJANG! She is a ranged character who fights using a massive grenade launcher.

notes.title: Guerilla Test Build Changes
notes.notes:
New characters ឵Rei and ឵Tetanuchi឵ join ASURAJANG!

 These characters are still in development and are still incomplete. Please take this into consideration.


A ឵Loser's Redemption឵ system was added to address the frustration caused by early eliminations in the Battle Royale genre.

 In-game, this is called the "Purgatory" system.

 Teams that are wiped out in the early to mid-game are sent to the Purgatory, and will be returned to the Battle Royale Arena if they survive for a set amount of time.

 Check it out for yourself in-game for more details!

The ឵"Soul Transfer" system was added to add an element of excitement when eliminated players spectate their teammates.


 This system allows eliminated players to provide a huge amount of HP and Stamina recovery to their surviving teammates by consuming their Soul(/Reboot Coin).

 Use it in a moment of danger to create a chance to turn the tables on the enemy!


A ឵"Damage Scaling" ឵system was added to prevent players from being eliminated without a chance to counter when hit by extended combo attacks.

 When a player is hit a certain number of times consecutively, the damage they receive is adjusted accordingly.

 When the combo count reaches a certain threshold, the damage is scaled according to a system called "burst."

 Check out the details for yourself in-game!


In-game Balance Adjustments

 Reduced the overall stat buffs provided by Astras in order to reduce the unreasonableness of loot differences.

 Critical Hits were removed from the combat system to reduce unpredictability in combat.

 Most characters have been rebalanced.


Quality Of Life Improvements

 Action Info can be displayed mid-game in Battle Royale matches by pressing F1.

 Detailed action info can be found in the Character Selection Screen - Combat Action Info.

 Pressing the F key to loot items now automatically prioritizes items that are useful to the player.

 Character dialogue is displayed on screen to supplement ping markers.

 Many other Quality Of Life changes were made as well.


Other changes have been applied according to Next Fest feedback as well. Please check them out in-game!
